name: Securities Transfer
definition: Completion of a securities settlement instruction, wherein securities are delivered/debited from a securities account and received/credited to the designated securities account.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of a transfer, as assigned by the instructing party.

TransferType.name: Transfer Type
TransferType.definition: Specifies whether the financial instrument is transferred as an asset or as cash.

OwnAccountTransferIndicator.name: Own Account Transfer Indicator
OwnAccountTransferIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the transfer results in a change of beneficial owner.

LateDeliveryDate.name: Late Delivery Date
LateDeliveryDate.definition: Date and time after the settlement date specified in the trade, used for pool trades resulting from the original To Be Assigned (TBA) securities.

TransactionIdentification.name: Transaction Identification
TransactionIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of a securities transfer.

Account.name: Account
Account.definition: Specifies the account from/to which the securities are transferred.

RelatedSettlement.name: Related Settlement
RelatedSettlement.definition: Settlement process which is the source of the transfer operation.

PhysicalDelivery.name: Physical Delivery
PhysicalDelivery.definition: Information related to physical delivery of the securities.

TransferTax.name: Transfer Tax
TransferTax.definition: Tax related to the transfer of a financial instrument.

SecuritiesDeliveryObligation.name: Securities Delivery Obligation
SecuritiesDeliveryObligation.definition: Obligation for one party to deliver securities to another party.

BookEntry.name: Book Entry
BookEntry.definition: Record in a securities account resulting from the transfer of a security.
